purpose: Reviewed cap states for master files whose blob-count guess was wrong or ambiguous. dedupe.py treats these as explicit evidence (outranks the heuristic; never a filename or folder label). Only the cap-beside file of each pair is listed: with it explicit, the mis-read capped twin is outranked and the cap-on source stays the curated Capped-folder copy already published.
